image_description: A top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) displaying its characteristic oval shape. The dorsal surface features eight distinct, overlapping calcareous plates arranged in a linear series from anterior to posterior. These plates are embedded in a thick, textured, leathery girdle that forms the outer rim. The image appears to be a scientific illustration or a high-resolution photograph of a specimen, showing mottled greenish-grey coloration on the plates and a brownish, granular texture on the girdle.
